integrity: Proof uses exact Brownian hitting transforms and strict convexity; computation supports but does not replace proof. Prior work contains renewal formulas and methods; only the global binary hidden-target optimization and discounted extremality are advanced as findings.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional Brownian search, independent Poisson reset clock, fixed symmetric target support, random target drawn once; fixed reset rate, zero relocation costs, immediate relocation and the same launch law. Laplace-transform superiority is not ordinary stochastic dominance. General-target optimal resetting and real-world implementation remain unproved.
title: Two-target bang–bang resetting: exact bias thresholds and universal discounted optimality
